A Voice for the Common: Reforms to Education, Reincentivizing the Trades

The Mayor of Velnaz revealed a new program for the city, an experiment to be implemented across the Empire. Called The Forum Project, it aims to create a means by which the issues facing the people are properly communicated to the Imperial Structures. On an at-will basis, property owners may offer to host conferences, handled by an Imperial Committee, that allow for discussion between citizens registered to a party.

The Party Registration requirements are simple: A completed Registration form with 10 signatures and matching photocopies of any recognized Imperial ID (and/or a foreign or domestic passport). Depending on the capacity of the local chapter, there may be a cutoff based on party size. Local chapters (meeting locations) will host conventions where, after discussion of policy, a Chapter Delegation will be elected based on the top 10% of Candidates (one candidate per party, each person gets a vote)
The Chapter Delegation from there will meet at a Regional Convention and decide which issues are put forth to the Imperial Structures OR District Conventions.

The Imperial structures would also be assuming ownership of the Universities- adding Educators to the Basic Income Commissary list, and waiving tuition for large portions of the student body for this fiscal year. This move was made after the recent success in the new Nationalized Sector of Koranvistani business, encompassing state owned companies that have recently benefitted from sweeping automation.

Interesting research has started at the University of Attika in light of recent layoffs- employment in more neglected regions of the economy has increased, as well as small, independent businesses. Anecdotal evidence included as part of the study claims that parties and night life have gotten more vibrant, and spending has increased at bars and restaurants.

All this does come amidst the difficulties that come with the situation in the White Strait. Following Cieskhalias addition to the Empire. However, several oil-drilling operations in the Autonomous Republics north are supplying Imperial needs, and the nations access to Lithium and Aluminium minerals has allowed the tech sector to blossom further.

[quote=new_westmore;61563251][b]Statement on Dalesburg International Airport Terrorist Attack[/b]
[i]The Democratic Republic of New Westmore has reason to believe that the incident which occurred in Dalesburg International Airport two days ago was a terrorist attack backed by the Sealiphate of Irocco.

Two days ago, an airliner took off from Dalesburg International Airport carrying a large quantity of contraband arms and drugs. This contraband was subsequently dropped over Dalesburg during its flight around the city. The motive as to why remains unclear, but Federal Police investigators have proposed that this was done as a tactic to intimidate or to incite a call to arms against authorities. After the airplane returned to the airport, the occupants on board attempted to escape authorities, and blew up their airplane on the runway as they fled to destroy the evidence. A shootout occurred after, resulting in the deaths of four of our officers and the arrests of two of the men on board. We are still searching for the third occupant of the aircraft. We suspect that the man on the run may have been the pilot in control. We are encouraging anyone with information about this man to come forward as soon as possible - the sooner we get him into custody, the safer our nation will be from this threat of terrorism.

We demand an explanation from the Sealiphate of Irocco. If no explanation is provided, or if our suspicions are vilified, we will push for sanctions and for further action to be taken against them, which may include a total embargo, removal from the Corridor Treaty or condemnation from the ICJ. We will also be completely terminating our bilateral relations with the Sealiphate until further notice - any Westmorians inside Irocco are encouraged to leave before the end of the month.

We strongly condemn any act of terrorism against our nation, and we will not take kindly to foreign actors maliciously interfering with the order of our society. Let it be known that we will not bow to terror regimes that seek to oppress us or disrupt our way of life.[/i]

[nation]Irocco[/nation]
[nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]
[nation]Oceanices[/nation]
[nation]Tirakan[/nation]
[nation]Vespurias[/nation][/quote]
[b]Disgust[/b]

The Sealiphate of Irocco, since the collapse of the unjust caliphates, has been a proponent of righteous law and morality; it is the beacon of Islamic Jusprudence in a world which has turned its back on the laws of the Most Merciful and the words of the Most Noble Messenger. It is an insult to this legacy and this way of life that the Democratic Republic of New Westmore would declare us terrorists. Terrorists do not serve the interests of God; to kill innocents would be a violation of the Shari'ah, our morality, our principles. We disagree with the Democratic Republic of New Westmore on many things, secularism, its policy on Mizrahel, its current leadership, but we would never kill the innocent. Nor would we distribute the tools necessary to corrupt the youth of any nation, that being in this instance, opium. 

It is suspected by Amir Al-Mu'mineen that, in fact, the suspects were not Iroccoan, and merely had forged Iroccoan documents to service the export of opium from whatever Cartel influence and products that remain unburned or transformed into legal substances in Maiqahstan. If these are Maiqah, or if they are Iroccoan, it matters not. For they sought to act as corrupters of the world in our name, thus we request that they be extradited to Irocco for punishment under Divine law. As for the investigation, Amir Al-Mu'mineen suggests that his personal bodyguards, the Haras of Irocco, might serve in the search for the third devil, who might likewise proclaim themself a fraudulent slave of God.

As for actions that the Sealiphate will undertake personally, we humbly offer our deepest sympathies for this event orchestrated by these villains. Furthermore, the Sealiphate will initiate a crackdown on all Maiqahistani Mintaqahs to ensure that no more opium and arms will be drawn from that already deeply bloodied stone. May this satisfy the New Westmorian government, we would wish to reenstate our bilateral treaty.

Peace be upon those who follow His guidance,

Chancellor of Foreign Affairs
Imam Khalid 'the Learned' Safvid

Greetings, and thank you for your inquiry to the Li'ist Socialist Technate of Stuipendia. You have inquired about the mass nationalisation of industry into the crown in order to further Socialist and Technocratic Ideals. This is very valuable to us in the Technate. Student of Perfection, Ma Qi, who himself studied personally under Li Jinping during his lectures on the implementation of a Socialist-Technocratic order, has attempted to compile a short and simple collection of steps for the implementation of a Koranvistani brand of Li'ist Socialist Technocracy. It is hoped that this will serve as a guide to your revolutionary crown on how to pursue the perfect system.

[list=1]
[*]Remove all influences of Entropy, in this instance, for a temporary period, ensure the absolute authority of the Crown to prevent any foreign influence from corrupting the pursuit of Perfection.
[*]Establish a Vanguard Politburo of political scholars who command a Vanguard Army of dedicated soldiers of the Crown to undertake the next steps.
[*]Eliminate corporations by force, in this instance, you should make use of the Vanguard Army to seize all corporate assets under the sole authority of the Crown until such a time as a meritocracy can be sorted to undertake forge a Directorate of Leading Technocrats who will be able to maximise the efficiency of all industries, in the meantime continue production as needed by the state.
[*]Rally the working class to this new cause; this is rather self-explanatory. Typical populist rhetoric applies here; you may use things such as faith or the tradition of the Crown to rally the proletariat behind this new and righteous cause.
[*]Establishment of the Li'ist exam system, formation of the Intelligence and Physical exams are necessary to the establishment of assigned labour. Though, of course, those who succeed in Intelligence examinations are permitted to study whatever field they so choose.
[*]Begin to phase out currency where possible; this depends heavily on the state of your nation.
[*]It may be your wish at this point to abolish the monarchy and replace it with the title of Overseer Superior, though that is up to your discretion.
[/list]

Further communication is welcome. It is hoped that this e-mail will permit furthering of the Worldwide Revolution.

Warm Regards,

Kai Bu

[b]1915: Lev[/b]
The train rumbled along the open tracks, the cars swaying and clacking hypnotically. Lev Ansfarne had found himself lulled to a period of much needed sleep, only to be awakened by the whistle that blew into the night. Shifting in his seat he made note of the snow that fell upon the deciduous forests, piling onto the ground for some happy child to come play around in.

Lev smirked, he had once been happy, however the tragedies came, and like most in his age in this time, he had not been happy for some time. 

Afore him was an old Thrømm woman, her head wrapped in a clean red and white scarf she was clearly not like the others he had seen working in the fields of the manors, she had escaped it seemed.

Escape, it was a word which Lev had once pondered deeply, his chest tightening and tears rolling down his face as he demanded of God why the tragedies had come, but, as the priest had told him Many things may go to grave,

Lev bit his lip to keep the emotions from rolling within him, not now, not here. The old woman shifted in her sleep, not here, not now.

Excuse me young man, intoned a polite voice beside his ear, he jerked his head, startled at the voice, beside him was a mustachioed man, smiling.

Yes? Asked Lev, attempting to hide his annoyance and surprise.

Is someone sitting in your bench? Aside you? Asked the man, pointing at the empty spot by the window.

No sir, intoned Lev, unsure as what to say of the man, who upon Levs reply promptly plopped himself down beside.

The man peered out of the window and then intoned to Lev, Cold? 

Yes, very, and it is supposed to be spring, heavens I shall very much be glad to be rid of this landscape, he replied with a shake of his head.

Travelling to warmer climes? Asked the man.

Yes, Rosenmarkke, Vysjllá, 

Ah, that is delightful, it is a very nice place I have heard, replied the man.

The conversation continued with polite laughter and all the readiness of one who has been forced to talk to another person without their consent, however, Lev found himself in need of the conversation, which turned to the man's moustache and his experiences in the Montfleurois war of 1884.

Left me with a wheeze, and I have gone up to see the doctors in these northern parts, and what have they gave to me? Nothing but debt! He said slapping his knee.

Indoubtably, these northern doctors have an eye for the shine of a coin, and then nothing else! Intoned another passenger with a laugh.

Ah but surely the doctor at least gave you residence? Asked Lev.

Oh he gave residence, but it was a penny more and far less help than I had planned, replied the man, Now ho! What brings you to these parts, are you from Vysjllá? 

I am, nodded Lev, I grew up there,

Ah lucky, lucky, but I am even luckier, you see I grew up in that place of places, Mont Sur Lune! Replied the man with a smile.

Mont-sur-Lune? Laughed Lev, And I now speak with an enemy of Rosenmarkke! 

Ah the war has passed, the king seeks peace now, the man replied.

Peace, chortled an old voice. Lev looked over and noticed the old Thrømm lady had awakened.

Ah, sorry to disturb you, he hurriedly said, but the old doe gave no parry.

No, no, she waved her thin hand, I couldnt help but hear your conversation, 

Yes, it is a noble thing that Philippe dEstienne has sought to make peace with his family's past, said the mustachioed man.

Bah, waved the old doe, A man promises peace one morning, the next he has bludgeoned a man to death, 

Yes, peace is such a fickle thing, replied Lev with a sigh.

But it is achievable, and I do believe it is achievable right now. emphasised the man with the moustache, tapping the side of the upholstered train bench.

As long as man or non-man tries to attempt peace, and peace on his own terms, there will never be any peace, said the old lady.

Lev frowned, You sound like a preacher I once heard on the street corner, one of those protestants, he mused.

Ah, you are not? asked the old lady.

Lev shook his head, I havent been too frequent in my religious affairs, I of course go to church and see the priest, but that is not very often, 

Well, you know what the philosophers say, religion is a dying art, progress looks forward! intoned the mustachioed man. 

You have read Nels? asked Lev to the man.

Oh yes, Ive read all of them, Nels, Rathenbourge, Walsham, listed the man.

I believe Nels wrote a new book, replied Lev, Have you seen it? 

Alas, Ive not read the serials as of late, frowned the man.

Well, it is a lot of good ideas, he points out the disparities between people and leadership in his newest work, replied Lev enthusiastically.

Now, madame, I assume you are of the faith, asked the mustachioed man.

Of course I am, snarked the doe. 

Ah, shame, my father was of the faith, he lived a good lifebut one does wonderwhy the faithful are often poor, replied Lev.

Because we forgo worldly riches to repose in heavenly riches later, replied the old doe with a matter-of-fact tone.

But if someone gives up their money in life and cannot live comfortably, and then dies because their circumstances are so poor, what good is their faith? asked the mustachioed man, leaning forward.

The question you ask hinges on the core assumption that one needs comfort to live, intoned the old lady.

I disagree, his assumption is to the detriment of losing oneself, replied Lev.

Right so, intoned the man, See, if someone has the ability and the money by which to live and live their lives fully, yet chooses to give up that life in favour of potentially perishing in the snow, have they not wasted their life? asked the man.

Once again, it seems you assume one needs comfort and money by which to live, replied the old lady.

Well of course they do! interjected Lev with a shake of his head, A person needs a house, a way to pay for food, and that in fact is an argument that Nels writes in his new book. 

The old woman shook her head and laughed with a smile, The Lord says that we need not worry about these things; in fact, he points out the crows and the birds of the fields are fed by the Lord himself. 

But in winter, birds die? interjected the mustachioed man.

A point, Lev replied.

But do they? Aren't birds built to travel south to warmer climes? See, the Lord provides even in their innermost natures, replied the woman.

I must ask, how have we gotten here? asked the mustachioed man. I think I must use the lavatory, excuse me, sir, he said as he stood up and passed by Lev.

Lev acknowledged the man, nodded at the woman who had begun once more to stare back out the window, and then turned to the frozen lake that they were passing by.

It had been Lev's hope that the man with the mustache would return; he internally lamented the fact that he had not gotten his name, he had little companionship in his day-to-day, and his quiet demeanor kept him at a distance from the loud, raucous society that surrounded him. 

The train rumbled on into the waning hours of the evening, and Lev soon found his eyes closing once more into the sweet embrace of sleep.

[quote=lyuongo;61565274][spoiler=[b][i]ESCAPE FROM NAYPINAU![/i][/b]]
[i]President Tung took one last look around the Presidential Palace. It was quiet, bar the helicopter idiling on the roof, awating his appearance. 

Just miles to the south, on the National Highway, the roar of revolution reverberated through the Lyuongoan countryside. Thousands of men, trucks and the red spirit were on a collision course to the capital. Tung ordered the preparation of defenses along the ancient city quarters, however, he knew it was only a matter of time. The remaining troops in Naypinau were to flee to the major port city of Uria, while the rest of the remaining loyalists were to report to command stations in Durgo, Jayunggi and Ryuloga. It would be best now to take stock and prepare their counterattack when the LNA could pick the board in which the final game will be played. Various LMC-employed militias have also pledged loyalty towards the LNA... but you can't exactly rely on mercenaries to be ride or die allies. Tung knew that.

"Your execllency. It's time, we have to go now before the LNSA can get their jets sortied!"

The rain came down in sheets. Fighting in the Naypinau streets were marked with blurred flashes and bangs, but the hundreds of bodies that now lay dead and disfigured in the wet pavement are gracefully covered by the fog of the rain, which washes blood, guts and limbs down the street gutters. Tanks, covered by the fog, trampled mercilessly over friend and foe alike in the confusion. Artillery hit about as many belligerents as it hit civilians. The song of smoke, fog and fire rang out to both the damned and the innocent that night. Even still, the LNSA pushed on, rallied by the great national hero. By the time the sun rose in the morning to shine over the wounded and dead, the LNSA cut off any exits from Naypinau for the remaining loyalists, and from there, it was shooting fish in a barrel. The remaining massacre would last deep into the 18th of May, as the remaining souls of the loyalists would be vanquished with an revolutionary exorcism of the city, regressed to a morbid mass grave covered in bits of pieces of rubble and human matter. In  the meantime, sandbags and barbed wire defenses were being prepared around the perimeter of Uria, with the knowledge that for the LNA to recieve the support it needs for its counterattack, [b]Operation 5692[/b], they had to hold the city of Uria for as long as possible. A job placed into the hands of decades-old tanks and a few thousand men with the resolve of a nation on their backs. They would need every little bit of that resolve, as the Navy, now in Hein Wei's hands, has cut off their escape. They must fight long enough for victory or die waiting for a savior.[/i]
[/spoiler]

[i][u][b]The South Beach Shooting[/b][/u]
May 24, 2028

From the coastal district of Lavs Anlynd City, South Beach Bay became the center of celebration as it hosted a historic festival the first-ever LGBTQ Multicultural Species Festival. Organized by the city government, the event marked the anniversary of the Rukatis communitys liberation from decades of segregation and systemic discrimination.

The festival was a large scale music concerts, cultural conventions, nightclub gatherings, and a wide array of LGBTQ+ events. Over 450,000 attendees, both foreign visitors and citizens of Oceanica, flooded South Beach to take part in the event.

Festivities officially began at 5:40 PM, continuing deep into the night.  By midnight, the celebration had reached its peak.

At 12:08 AM, everything changed. Five individuals, later identified as members of a far-right neo-human extremist group, initiated a coordinated attack. Armed and deliberate, they opened fire into densely packed areas of the festival. Panic spread instantly as the sounds of gunfire shattered the night. What had been progress events turned into one of the deadliest mass shootings in the history of the United States of Oceanica.

The first gunshots sent waves of confusion through South Beach Bay. For several seconds, many attendees mistook the noise for fireworks until the screams began. Within moments, panic erupted.

Thousands surged in every direction, stampeding through festival grounds, overturning barriers, and abandoning belongings in a desperate attempt to escape. Emergency lines were flooded with calls as witnesses reported multiple shooters. 

By 12:11 AM, the Lavs Anlynd City Police Department had received dozens of confirmed reports of an active mass shooting. Officers stationed nearby were the first to respond, rushing toward the sound of gunfire while directing civilians away from danger. Within minutes, additional units, including tactical response teams, were dispatched.

At 12:16 AM, law enforcement engaged the attackers. The confrontation was brief but intense. Three of the assailants were neutralized at the scene, while two attempted to flee toward the marina district before being apprehended after a short pursuit. Authorities later confirmed that all five suspects were part of an organized extremist group, driven by neo-human supremacist ideology targeting non-human and LGBTQ communities.

Emergency medical services arrived almost immediately after police secured the area. Ambulances, fire rescue teams, and volunteer medics were fast responding at South Beach. Makeshift triage zones were established along the promenade, where the injured were treated under overwhelming conditions.

Local hospitals entered mass casualty protocols. Doctors and nurses worked through the night as victims were transported in waves. Blood banks issued urgent calls for donations, and neighboring cities dispatched additional medical personnel to assist. Families gathered outside emergency rooms, desperately seeking news of loved ones.

By sunrise, the scale of the tragedy became clear. Dozens were confirmed dead, with hundreds more injured, many critically. The South Beach Shooting quickly became one of the deadliest attacks in Oceanican history, sending shockwaves across the nation and the international community.

[b]Government and National Response.[/b]

 By early morning, the President of the United States of Oceanica addressed the nation in an emergency broadcast. Condemning the attack as an act of terror against unity, identity, and freedom, the President declared a national day of mourning and ordered flags to be flown at half staff.

Federal agencies from the Federal Bureau of Special Investigation, took immediate control of the investigation alongside local authorities. Intelligence divisions began tracing the origins of the extremist group, uncovering online networks, funding channels, and potential affiliates.
Security was heightened nationwide.

Major cities increased police presence at public gatherings, particularly at LGBTQ+ venues and multicultural centers. Borders and transport hubs were placed on elevated alert as officials assessed the possibility of further coordinated attacks.

[b]Public Reaction[/b]

Within hours, vigils began forming across Lavs Anlynd City candles lining sidewalks, flowers covering barricades, and messages of love and defiance written in chalk along the streets of South Beach. Social media was flooded with tributes, as the names and faces of victims began to emerge.

Governor of Lavs Anlynd the First Lady and Rukits Sheep, Merry Hill issued statements of support, condemning extremism and expressing condolences. Advocacy groups called for stronger protections against hate driven violence, while communities mourn the lost.

The Newly Christened National Salvation Navy, under the command of its Heinian Loyalist Admiral, named Thibaw Min uses the full naval might of Lyuongo to fire upon the city of Uria, it would use the small arms fire upon each of the vessels, those being the 7 Type 056 corvette's and 4 Type 053 frigate's as his seamen are mentally incapable of understanding the torpedo loading and firing system. Nonetheless, the small arms fire would rip into buildings of any make or shape. The indiscriminate attacks of the National Salvation Navy would be a later point of contention that Marshal Hein would condemn Thibaw Min for when he heard of it, but as it stood, bullets ripped through anyone not in cover. The sheer idocy of the navies command was not the fault of the revolution, but nonetheless its stupidity was there. Amidst the Lyuongo monsoon, a Type 056 corvette is damaged.

In tandem with this assault by sea, the attack by air would be undertaken by 18 MiG-29s who, unlike the navy, deliberately targeted any mercenary or military cowled personal. This would go on for several hours, assaulted by air increasing as more Migs took to the skies. Though it would only be a handful before Honoured Marshal Hein Wei would order the Migs to fly off and away from Uria as he ordered several batteries of artillery to fire before he undertook a personal assault with his men, though he brought a reduced force, as he stationed several thousand in Naypina to keep law and order, assist with the dead and generally hold the city. Like again, his convoy would hit the already battered city like a hammer, once more he would personally engage, cigarette at his lips under the rain as he fired on Republican troops with his engraved pistol. 

During the battle, a rallying cry amongst the National Salvation Army would be heard, once shouted by Hein as he fought insurgents in the jungles of Lyuongo, [i][b]"Bombard the Headquarters!"[/b][/i][/spoiler][/quote]
[spoiler=Uria]
Petty Officer Thet Mg looked over his map laid across a cheap, plastic table. His defenses were colored chocolate candies spread across the city's perimeter, and the LNSA's formidable offensive brunt a couple of chocolate bars, shaking across the table as artillery fire smashes the city of Uria. He stared at the cheap, makeshift operations room in disgust. Sad. Sad, he thought, how many men will die for some sh*thole place like this. He couldn't believe there was honor dying for a city of concrete rubble of plastic. Men were supposed to die guarding the damsel in distress, massive civilizations of marble and pageantry. Not this. Not this ugly motherf-cking hole in the ground. 

Meanwhile, on the front lines, men shot in the head rolled down the makeshift mound-trenches into the arms of fellow men. Strafing MiGs turned whole groups of men into ground beef prime for taco Tuesday. The few decrepit tanks the LNA dragged from
Naypinau laid the only support artillery for the besieged forces. It was never a question of if, but when the LNSA took the last LNA foothold in the north. For now, however, the LNA held strong. A MiG fired off another missle. Thet Mg flicked another circular chocolate off the map. 

Down south in Ryuloga, President Tung met with officials from the Lyuongoan Mining Corporation. General consensus was that the jungle provided ample defense to keep operating uranium mining operations in the south, and that they needed to use this advantage over the LNSA to vie for foreign support. Further, the LNA must keep its Northern and Southern forces together. What happened at Naypinau and currently at Uria is unacceptable from here on out. The LNA does not have the manpower to waste on entanglements isolated from air support. The LNA would have to figure out a new military doctrine on the fly...

"MISTER PRESIDENT, SIR!" A underlying ranker came flying into the meeting room.

"What is it, Private?"

"... Two MiGs crashed while running exercises..."

"...
